Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams audio chunks from an async source using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 2 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 3 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 4 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 5 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 6 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import asyncio
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, Dict, Optional

from azure.cognitiveservices.speech import AudioDataStream, AudioStreamFormat
from azure.cognitiveservices.speech import ResultReason, SpeechConfig, SpeechRecognizer
from azure.cognitiveservices.speech.audio import PushAudioInputStream, AudioConfig


@dataclass
class TranscriptChunk:
    text: str
    is_final: bool
    raw: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None


async def stream_speech_to_text(
    audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes],
    language: str = "en-US",
) -> AsyncIterator[TranscriptChunk]:
    speech_key = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_KEY"]
    speech_region = os.environ["AZURE_SPEECH_REGION"]

    speech_config = SpeechConfig(subscription=speech_key, region=speech_region)
    speech_config.speech_recognition_language = language

    stream_format = AudioStreamFormat.get_wave_format_pcm(16000, 16, 1)
    push_stream = PushAudioInputStream(stream_format)
    audio_config = AudioConfig(stream=push_stream)
    recognizer = SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=speech_config, audio_config=audio_config)

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()

    def recognized_handler(evt):
        result = evt.result
        if result.reason == ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech and result.text:
            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(
                queue.put_nowait,
                TranscriptChunk(
                    text=result.text,
                    is_final=True,
                    raw={"offset": result.offset, "duration": result.duration},
                ),
            )

    def recognizing_handler(evt):
        result = evt.result
        if result.reason == ResultReason.RecognizingSpeech and result.text:
            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(
                queue.put_nowait,
                TranscriptChunk(
                    text=result.text,
                    is_final=False,
                    raw={"offset": result.offset, "duration": result.duration},
                ),
            )

    def canceled_handler(evt):
        details = evt.result
        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(
            queue.put_nowait,
            RuntimeError(f"Speech recognition canceled: {getattr(details, 'reason', 'unknown')}")
        )

    def session_stopped_handler(evt):
        loop.call_soon_threadsafe(queue.put_nowait, None)

    recognizer.recognized.connect(recognized_handler)
    recognizer.recognizing.connect(recognizing_handler)
    recognizer.canceled.connect(canceled_handler)
    recognizer.session_stopped.connect(session_stopped_handler)

    recognizer.start_continuous_recognition()

    async def pump_audio() -> None:
        try:
            async for chunk in audio_chunks:
                if chunk:
                    push_stream.write(chunk)
        finally:
            push_stream.close()

    pump_task = asyncio.create_task(pump_audio())

    try:
        while True:
            item = await queue.get()
            if item is None:
                break
            if isinstance(item, Exception):
                raise item
            yield item
    finally:
        recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition()
        await pump_task
